comparison.objective: Interlock three slotted boards into a partition; candidate adjusts a damper to produce safe repeatable stops.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual board stabilization, slot alignment, and downward insertion versus recessed hex-key use, fine collar rotation, and tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Two crossings interlocked within pose tolerances and aligned to a mark; no response tuning or witness-torque requirement.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual stabilization is generic; the tested assemblies and abilities differ materially.
